## Invitations

A total of 1488 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Attendance was 188, giving an overall attendance rate of 12.6. The result provides a clear measure of engagement with the outreach activity and will support planning for future invitations and attendance follow-up.

Invitations were distributed across the River Districts, with arrangements made to support access where local conditions permitted. Van days were maintained where roads allowed, helping the outreach service continue to reach the intended communities.

## Contact

Of the invitations issued, 1286 included an SMS contact. A reminder message was received by 1157 people. These contact measures were used to reinforce the invitation and provide a further prompt before attendance.

The attendance and contact figures will be considered in reviewing the approach to future outreach activity. The information also indicates the level of response achieved through the invitation and reminder process.

Prepared by G. Evans.
